status: implemented; fixed-target simulation and existing rules/type checks passed; moving encounters and TapTap device balance pending
scope: Level 40, equal 39 offensive attributes, starter weapons, no armour/forging/pets, stationary invulnerable dummies, fixed combat regeneration, no potions or infinite resources. Entry = all rank 1; developed = legal <=41 points; ceiling = every profession skill rank 5 (mathematical bound, not a legal build). WAR at 1.4m, ranged at 5.5m. Targets and between-action player positions are anchored; rush movement still runs during its action. Bow uses short tap basics. Movement-ready thunder is a conditional ceiling, not evidence of real movement execution. Not a moving-enemy or device acceptance.

comparison.interpretation: Melee retains a close-cluster advantage; fire benefits from sustained zone occupancy; thunder retains line/chain coverage; no claim that every formation must have identical damage.
